errors.evidence: The description claims the bars alternate in color. In fact, specific models (all GPT models) are consistently colored solid blue to distinguish them from the other models, which are a lighter teal-blue. It is a highlighting scheme, not an alternating one.
The description fails to mention that the bars in the first chart, titled "Understanding," are sorted in descending order of value. The prompt specifically requires mentioning any sorting.
